name: test_create_pipeline_version_save_list_switch_preserves_canvas_state
description:
Save As Version creates 'v1_test' with the LLM node preserved;
    switching to 'base' shows the original (node-less) topology; switching
    back to 'v1_test' restores the LLM node — each version's canvas state is
    independently preserved with no cross-version leakage.
descriptionHtml:
Save As Version creates 'v1_test' with the LLM node preserved;
switching to 'base' shows the original (node-less) topology; switching
back to 'v1_test' restores the LLM node — each version's canvas state is
independently preserved with no cross-version leakage.

steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the dedicated (zero-node) pipeline's canvas and verify the clean 'base' baseline
Step 2 — Add an LLM node via the canvas "Add node" menu
Step 3 — Click "Save As Version"; verify the "Create version" dialog, type "v1_test", and confirm
Step 4 — Open the VERSION dropdown and verify it lists both "base" and "v1_test"
Step 5 — Switch back to 'base' and verify the canvas reverts to the original (node-less) topology — no cross-version leakage
